description: Battle engineer - dons a powered Mechsuit to soak damage and hit hard.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 13 confirmed Mechanics nodes trimmed to a lean 12-node tree per Kyle's bloat direction - the 5+ separate Mechsuit sub-buttons (Mechsuit: Activate/Combustion/Artillery/Sawblade) confirmed via tooltip were consolidated into ONE Mechsuit form-toggle talent with a fixed small kit while active, rather than kept as individually-trained abilities. Tooltip confirmed real form mechanics: 'Activate your Mechsuit, draining 5 Scrap every sec, increasing damage dealt by 10%, your armor by 800, and movement speed by 15%. If you run out of Scrap while active, you are ejected... your Scrap Shot is transformed into Gatling Gun.' Modeled as a self-buff form (see requires_form pattern already in the engine) rather than a full new Scrap-resource-drain system, since Kyle confirmed forms/pets are a planned future system to build properly.

nodes.name: Build: Mechsuit
nodes.description: Don a powered Mechsuit for 15 sec, draining 5 Scrap per turn: gain +10% damage dealt, +800 Armor, and +15% movement speed, and gain access to Mechsuit: Laser Beam and Mechsuit: Combustion. Ejected early if Scrap runs out.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Activate your Mechsuit, draining 5 Scrap every sec, increasing damage dealt by 10%, your armor by 800, and your movement speed by 15%. If you run out of Scrap while active, you are ejected from the Mechsuit.' Kyle's real correction from today's leveling-doc session: while Mechsuit is active, real screenshot-confirmed Mechsuit: Laser Beam/Combustion become castable (form-locked via requires_form=["mechsuit"]) rather than Scrap Shot literally transforming into a different ability - 'we can just make them form locked, likely easier.' Applies the real tinker_mechsuit_form StatusEffect (see combat/status_effects.py, entities/character.py's current_mechsuit derived property).

nodes._source: reactive_shield_chance was a dead stat_mods key - converted to a real talent-level proc using the new generic absorb-shield support (StatusEffect.absorb, see combat/status_effects.py and Character.take_damage's new absorb-consumption step). chance is the PER-RANK value (5), scaled by Character._sync_talent_procs to the rank spent (5/10% across 2 ranks - same rank-scaling this method already does for Venomous Retort). Shield sized at 8% of the Tinker's own max HP via the new absorb_pct_max_health convenience field (the real tooltip gives no fixed number, and a flat value would be trivial at level 60 or overpowered at level 10). icd=3 (a short internal cooldown) keeps this from re-triggering every single hit once the chance roll succeeds a few times in a row, matching how a real WoW proc shield isn't meant to be permanently up.
